You are assembling a clinical visit note. The sentences of one note are listed below in random order with their section headings removed. File every sentence under one of these four headings: SUBJECTIVE, OBJECTIVE EXAM, OBJECTIVE RESULTS, ASSESSMENT AND PLAN. In the JSON, the headings are the keys subjective, objective_exam, objective_results and assessment_and_plan. Return each sentence ID under exactly one heading. Do not leave any sentence out and do not invent IDs.

S1: Musculoskeletal: Reports left-sided low back pain.
S2: No pain with palpation on the right side.
S3: MSK: Examination of the lumbar spine: No pain with flexion or extension.
S4: I explained that Vicodin is a strong medication for this issue and that I would need to refer him to pain management for that, but I did provide him with a prescription for Demerol.
S5: The patient is status post lumbar microdiscectomy performed in 11/2020.
S6: These reveal no evidence of fracture or other abnormalities in the spine or vertebrae.
S7: The patient reports that, prior to his microdiscectomy in 2020, he was taking high-dose gabapentin for severe nerve pain through his back and lower extremities.
S8: After reviewing the patient's examination and radiographic findings today, I believe his symptoms are related to a muscle strain due to spinal misalignment.
S9: The patient requested a prescription for Vicodin and Demerol.
S10: Normal range of motion.
S11: He is currently taking ibuprofen 800 mg daily.
S12: His previous surgical site is visible and appears to have healed properly.
S13: Stretching and ibuprofen 800 mg daily are helpful, but he denies having tried icing the area.
S14: Other than spontaneous flare-ups, his pain is worsened with excessive spinal flexion.
S15: Pain with weight-bearing.
S16: X-ray images of the lumbar spine were obtained and reviewed in office today.
S17: Dorsiflexion is normal.
S18: Low back pain, left side.
S19: The patient has been experiencing pain in the left side of his low back, generally localized around the surgical site of his microdiscectomy performed in 11/2020, but occasionally into the right side as well.
S20: I recommend that we treat the patient conservatively with formal physical therapy and meloxicam.
S21: Sean Phillips is a pleasant 35-year-old male who presents to the clinic today for the evaluation of left-sided low back pain.
S22: Pain with palpation on the left side around L5.
S23: No nerve pain in his lower extremities.
S24: Low back pain, left side.
